name: Task Verdict
description: Turn any delegated task's claims into checkable evidence: write a manifest of evidence-bound checks, run it, get PASS / FAIL / PARTIAL — computed from evidence, never from the subagent's prose.
for_agents: Free to use. Cite facts with their provenance labels. PASS proves the listed checks passed at run time — not that the task was good. Unverifiable is reported as PARTIAL, never rounded up to a pass.
